28:34 · 028 Al-Qasas

وَأَخِى هَـٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفْصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانًا فَأَرْسِلْهُ مَعِىَ رِدْءًا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

Word in this verse: يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ ۖ — who will confirm me

English (Sahih International): And my brother Aaron is more fluent than me in tongue, so send him with me as support, verifying me. Indeed, I fear that they will deny me."

English (Yusuf Ali): "And my brother Aaron - He is more eloquent in speech than I: so send him with me as a helper, to confirm (and strengthen) me: for I fear that they may accuse me of falsehood."

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور ہارون (جو) میرا بھائی (ہے) اس کی زبان مجھ سے زیادہ فصیح ہے تو اس کو میرے ساتھ مددگار بناکر بھیج کہ میری تصدیق کرے مجھے خوف ہے کہ وہ میری لوگ تکذیب کریں گے

34:20 · 034 Saba

وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

Word in this verse: صَدَّقَ — found true

English (Sahih International): And Iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers.

English (Yusuf Ali): And on them did Satan prove true his idea, and they followed him, all but a party that believed.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور شیطان نے ان کے بارے میں اپنا خیال سچ کر دکھایا کہ مومنوں کی ایک جماعت کے سوا وہ اس کے پیچھے چل پڑے

37:37 · 037 As-Saffat

بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

Word in this verse: وَصَدَّقَ — and confirmed

English (Sahih International): Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

English (Yusuf Ali): Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): بلکہ وہ حق لے کر آئے ہیں اور (پہلے) پیغمبروں کو سچا کہتے ہیں

37:105 · 037 As-Saffat

قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

Word in this verse: صَدَّقْتَ — you have fulfilled

English (Sahih International): You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

English (Yusuf Ali): "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): تم نے خواب کو سچا کر دکھایا۔ ہم نیکوکاروں کو ایسا ہی بدلہ دیا کرتے ہیں

39:33 · 039 Az-Zumar

وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ

Word in this verse: وَصَدَّقَ — and believed

English (Sahih International): And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.

English (Yusuf Ali): And he who brings the Truth and he who confirms (and supports) it - such are the men who do right.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور جو شخص سچی بات لے کر آیا اور جس نے اس کی تصدیق کی وہی لوگ متقی ہیں

56:57 · 056 Al-Waqiah

نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

Word in this verse: تُصَدِّقُونَ — you admit the truth

English (Sahih International): We have created you, so why do you not believe?

English (Yusuf Ali): It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): ہم نے تم کو (پہلی بار بھی تو) پیدا کیا ہے تو تم (دوبارہ اُٹھنے کو) کیوں سچ نہیں سمجھتے؟

66:12 · 066 At-Tahrim

وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ

Word in this verse: وَصَدَّقَتْ — And she believed

English (Sahih International): And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

English (Yusuf Ali): And Mary the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity; and We breathed into (her body) of Our spirit; and she testified to the truth of the words of her Lord and of His Revelations, and was one of the devout (servants).

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور (دوسری) عمران کی بیٹی مریمؑ کی جنہوں نے اپنی شرمگاہ کو محفوظ رکھا تو ہم نے اس میں اپنی روح پھونک دی اور اپنے پروردگار کے کلام اور اس کی کتابوں کو برحق سمجھتی تھیں اور فرمانبرداروں میں سے تھیں

70:26 · 070 Al-Maarij

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

Word in this verse: يُصَدِّقُونَ — accept (the) truth

English (Sahih International): And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

English (Yusuf Ali): And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور جو روز جزا کو سچ سمجھتے ہیں

Open on Quran.com

75:31 · 075 Al-Qiyamah

فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

Word in this verse: صَدَّقَ — he accepted (the) truth

English (Sahih International): And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.

English (Yusuf Ali): So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): تو اس (ناعاقبت) اندیش نے نہ تو (کلام خدا) کی تصدیق کی نہ نماز پڑھی

Open on Quran.com

92:6 · 092 Al-Layl

وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

Word in this verse: وَصَدَّقَ — And believes

English (Sahih International): And believes in the best [reward],

English (Yusuf Ali): And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور نیک بات کو سچ جانا
